raw.description: Hardcoded database credentials in the source code.
raw.exploit: An attacker with access to the source code can extract the database credentials and potentially gain unauthorized access to the database.

raw.description: Lack of CSRF protection on the '/api/contact' endpoint.
raw.exploit: An attacker can trick a logged-in user into submitting a form to the '/api/contact' endpoint, potentially sending unwanted messages.

raw.description: Potential reflected XSS vulnerability due to direct insertion of user input into the DOM without sanitization.
raw.exploit: An attacker can craft a malicious search query that includes JavaScript code, which could be executed in the user's browser when the search results are displayed.

raw.description: Generic error message returned to the client on database errors.
raw.exploit: An attacker can use the error message to infer the existence of certain database operations or tables, aiding in further attacks.
